title: Deeper/broader native-consumer outcomes and peer-evidence refresh
mode: primary-source web research and implementation-readiness refinement
scope: Reconcile current FreeCAD DXF importer backends and historical importer failure shapes
Refresh ACadSharp SPLINE and EED issue evidence against local plan owners
Refine native-consumer result fields without duplicating local findings or expanding routine validation

method.kind: Read official project documentation, source pages, and issue pages
method.limitations: Mutable project documentation/source pages were reviewed on 2026-10-18. FreeCAD issues #13597 and #13598 are closed and link follow-up PRs, but the PR diffs and a current native runtime were not inspected. ACadSharp #1299 exposes an attached archive, but neither it nor its member files were downloaded or hashed. No runtime result or current cross-platform qualification is claimed.

sources.project: FreeCAD Draft DXF documentation and importer source
sources.observed: FreeCAD exposes a built-in C++ DXF importer and an optional legacy Python importer. The documentation describes differing entity/output behavior and says the legacy path requires additional libraries. Current C++ source contains spline-to-Part::Feature handling. These sources establish route distinctions, not runtime behavior for a pinned build or effective user preference.

sources.revision: Issue pages retrieved 2026-10-18; both are closed and link PRs #16511 and #13638 respectively
sources.observed: The historical reports describe non-zero layer grouping loss and ignored requested native object-creation settings on the C++ importer route. They are useful acceptance-test shapes, but closure and linked PRs do not substitute for a current native runtime result; PR diffs were not inspected.

sources.project: ACadSharp issue #1299 and Autodesk/GDAL SPLINE references
sources.revision: Issue and documentation pages retrieved 2026-10-18; ACadSharp report names package 3.8.0
sources.observed: The open issue has an attached source/output archive, but its text provides no failing SPLINE handle, complete ordered field arrays, exact GDAL command/diagnostic, or independently expected curve. Autodesk defines the DXF field meanings; GDAL exposes a projection/tessellation route rather than an exact NURBS oracle. The issue's linked AI explanation is not technical evidence.

sources.revision: Issue page retrieved 2026-10-18; issue remains open in the reviewed issue index
sources.observed: The report gives an exact 32,768-byte per-APPID EED case that overflows through a signed 16-bit writer field and disappears on peer reread; it reports 32,764 bytes positive across AC1015, AC1018, and AC1032. This is peer implementation behavior, not a normative format maximum. Local unsigned boundary/splitting controls already own the corresponding question.

sources.project: LibreDWG manual and optional fuzz replay setup
sources.observed: The manual documents direction/version-specific conversion limits and states that some unknown DWG classes may be retained as blobs without DXF fields. The companion repository describes replaying stored crash/hang/leak cases as a regression practice. This supports a composed hardening checkpoint, not semantic feature coverage or a per-slice external test requirement.

existingPlanGatesRefined: PAR-22/7H/7I/7AB SPLINE field and curve semantics
assessment.planImpact: Refine the existing FreeCAD consumer manifest to capture the exact importer/backend and effective settings, source-to-native entity disposition, native object type, layer membership, and geometry measurements as distinct outcomes. Keep the public ACadSharp SPLINE archive optional and scratch-only; do not block local implementation or commit it. Keep existing generated EED boundary tests and the reduced fast-validation cadence unchanged.

workingTree.reason: The shared worktree already contains broad user/work-in-progress changes; this research pass changed only the requested plan and its receipt.
